title: H25 bookkeeping optimization plan
authorization: User explicitly requested all three priorities, concurrent agent swarming including research, and a goal to finish the tasks. Existing Chrome publication authorization continues.

baseline.head: 4f4159820c37f01d245784d1186bd51fcbc8ebb6
baseline.arm: PR5995 native C configuration with all original qualification controls; NOT the older Python-only arm

target.scope: complete frozen historical H25 qualification with retained observations

lanes.contract: Precompute private sets from admitted triples; retain every original pairwise intersection/equality check and fallback for unsupported inputs.
Deduplicate identical function records and build failure messages only on failure; keep every distinct freshness check at the same call boundary; assess a native implementation only if justified.
Reduce temporary tuples/dictionaries/JSON/bytes and hash crossings; retain canonical bytes, ordering, exact types, prefixes, counters and failure semantics.
Independently review proposals, aliasing/callback/fallback/freshness/byte contracts, interference and added cost; no implementation ownership.

parallel: implementation in disjoint owned paths after gates

gates: G0 refreshed canonical guidance/live overlap/baseline and shared contract freeze
G1 parallel source research and independent review; measurable-headroom decision
G2 finite correctness and all new-control cost freeze for each candidate
G3 individual bounded full pilot comparisons, not component gain promises
G4 combined integration and fresh fixed BCCBBC comparison against PR5995 native baseline
G5 normal/O finite, assertion-on complete, readonly Git-free/export/source/metadata/commit checks
G6 focused Chrome publication, exact-head hosted CI and required handoff readbacks
noise_rule: Combined fresh baseline median minus candidate median must exceed max(baseline range,candidate range) separately for wall and CPU, AND both reductions >=15%; predeclare six cold BCCBBC processes and retain all samples.
completion: All three priorities have reviewed final dispositions: qualified integration or reproducible scoped stop
Combined >=15% complete wall AND CPU target and noise gates pass before calling the performance goal achieved
All outputs/types/coverage/independent oracles/source pins and full new costs retained
Useful artifacts published via Chrome with exact-head checks and handoffs; no merge/frontier change
No unfinished required work; target misses reported as unmet, never a fabricated win
initial_dispatch: Source-only research and contract mapping; no compilers, numerical runs or implementation until the corresponding gate.

repeated_call_reduction.deliverable: CALL-BUDGET.json per priority plus one parent diagnostic call census when discriminating
repeated_call_reduction.P1: metadata/set constructors primary; loop fusion or intersection-result reuse separate research gate
repeated_call_reduction.P2: identity dedup, equivalent inline failure paths and lazy messages; retain each distinct live check at same boundary
repeated_call_reduction.P3: stateless per-record construction/encoding and crossings; immediate hash/counter semantics retained
repeated_call_reduction.integration: reuse only proven admitted private metadata; no shared answers or cached PASS
repeated_call_reduction.coordination: One parent inventory/upstream refresh/run index; batch independent bounded reads; reuse source gates only while exact digests/dependencies match; external refresh at publication/CI boundaries with revision waits; no reuse of live scientific PASS or declared cold costs
